message:
I would have to say that games and writing share the same concerns of knowing the audience and how to deploy one's talents to bring about some end.  I wouldn't say that it's the only way to teach writing, but it seems like a decent coupling of an activity some students may already enjoy with a practice that they are learning about.  In that regard, it doesn't really seem that different from playing a foreign language tag, or having a spelling bee.  Just a whole lot more technical.

Good to see you the other day, and I wish that your panel had been given a prime-time slot.  Too much important stuff was being discussed.
